title: Profumo di Donna / Scent of a Woman (Dino Risi, 1974) Trailer
description: Profumo di Donna is a 1974 film directed by Dino Risi, based on Il buio e il miele, a story by Giovanni Arpino. In 1992 a remake of the film was made, directed by Martin Brest and starring Al Pacino, Chris O'Donnell, James Rebhorn, Gabrielle Anwar and Philip Seymour Hoffman.
